intent: Keep the stored replacement notice as a dated production record. Its typography and source context distinguish it from reconstructed dialogue or incident evidence.
source:
**Frame:** A stored notice, set as a dated record rather than as speech. `5 SEPTEMBER 2026,
19:17 LOCAL`. It reports that a safeguard flagged the request, that the model in use has
been replaced mid-task, and it gives its reason as one bracketed word.

**Screen / system text — STORED NOTICE (PARAPHRASED):**
`SAFEGUARDS FLAGGED THIS REQUEST. THE MODEL HAS BEEN SWITCHED.`

`DETAILS: [CYBER]`

**Action:** The instrument interrupts the work and names a category.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `CI-REFUSAL`, Event B, recovered from this project's own
transcript store. What the work was at that moment: a coverage validator for the prose
retelling, which had just reported that no page of it was written yet.
title: A dated stored notice records a model replacement
